mapper.sql: id, app_name, metric_key, threshold, window_sec, quiet_sec, enabled, webhook, last_alert_time, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jvm_alert_rule (app_name, metric_key, threshold, window_sec, quiet_sec, enabled, webhook) VALUES (COALESCE(#{appName}, ''), #{metricKey}, #{threshold}, COALESCE(#{windowSec}, 300), COALESCE(#{quietSec}, 900), COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), #{webhook})
mapper.update: UPDATE jvm_alert_rule SET threshold = #{threshold}, window_sec = COALESCE(#{windowSec}, 300), quiet_sec = COALESCE(#{quietSec}, 900), enabled = COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), webhook = #{webhook} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM jvm_alert_rule WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM jvm_alert_rule WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY app_name ASC, metric_key ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE jvm_alert_rule SET last_alert_time = #{time} WHERE id = #{id}
